response.justification: While Bogdan demonstrates strong technical fundamentals with 15+ years of experience and proven ability to build systems at scale, he lacks critical domain expertise in experimentation platforms, A/B testing frameworks, metrics/telemetry infrastructure, and growth systems. The resume shows no evidence of experimentation design, feature flagging, statistical analysis for experiments, or data science collaborations. For a specialized Principal role focused on growth and experimentation systems, these gaps are too significant.
strengths: 15+ years of experience across required languages (C, C++, C#, Java, JavaScript/TypeScript), exceeding 8+ year requirement
Proven ability to build and maintain production systems at scale (millions of requests/transactions at multiple companies)
Strong technical leadership with emphasis on TDD, CI/CD, code quality, and mentoring engineers
concerns: No experience building experimentation platforms, A/B testing frameworks, or feature flagging systems
No evidence of metrics, telemetry, or instrumentation infrastructure work
No background in growth engineering, data analysis, or statistical methods for experiments
